name: io.rdapapi/rdap
title: RDAP API
description: Normalized JSON for any domain across 1,300+ TLDs, reading WHOIS where no RDAP server exists.

tools.name: domain-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized registration data (registrar, status, dates, nameservers, contacts) for a domain name, over RDAP or, for TLDs without it, WHOIS. A not-found error means the registry has no such name.

domain.description: The domain name to look up, e.g. "example.com". Unicode (IDN) names are accepted. Pass the registered domain, not a host such as "www.example.com".

follow.description: Follow the registrar RDAP link for richer data on thin registries such as .com and .net. Slower; defaults to false.

whois.description: Set false to refuse the WHOIS fallback, so a TLD with no RDAP server errors instead of answering over port 43. Defaults to true.

tools.name: bulk-domain-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP registration data for several domain names in one pooled call. Requires a Pro or Business plan; every domain in the batch counts against the quota.

domains.description: The domain names to look up, e.g. ["example.com", "example.net"]. Between 1 and 10 per call. Unicode (IDN) names are accepted. Pass registered domains, not hosts such as "www.example.com".

follow.description: Follow the registrar RDAP link for richer data on thin registries such as .com and .net. Slower; defaults to false.

whois.description: Set false to refuse the WHOIS fallback for every domain in the batch, so a TLD with no RDAP server returns not_supported. Defaults to true.

tools.name: ip-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP allocation data (network range, holder, country, status, geofeed URL) for an IP address or CIDR block.

prefix.description: Optional CIDR prefix length, e.g. 24. Must be 0-32 for IPv4 or 0-128 for IPv6.

tools.name: asn-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP data (holder, country, status, registration dates) for an autonomous system number.

tools.name: nameserver-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP data (IP addresses, status, sponsoring registrar) for a nameserver hostname.

tools.name: entity-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP data for an RIR entity handle — an organization or contact identifier such as "GOGL" or "ORG-RIEN1-RIPE". Only ARIN, RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC and AFRINIC handles resolve; a domain's registrar or registrant comes from domain-lookup instead.

tools.name: tlds
tools.description: List the TLDs this API can query, or describe one: which RDAP or WHOIS server answers for it, since when it has been supported, and how often that server fills each field. Metadata, so it never counts against the monthly quota.

tld.description: A single TLD to describe, e.g. "com" or ".io". Omit to list every supported TLD by name.

server.description: List only the TLDs served by this host, RDAP or WHOIS, e.g. "rdap.verisign.com". Ignored when "tld" is given.

since.description: List only the TLDs added after this ISO 8601 date, e.g. "2026-01-01". Ignored when "tld" is given.
